text: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine upon us, Selah
may all the peoples praise you.
for you rule the peoples justly and guide the nations of the earth. Selah
may all the peoples praise you.
and God, our God, will bless us.
and all the ends of the earth will fear him.
